dct_title_s: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines administrative level 0-1 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 1 level: - Admin 1: 6 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 17 July 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 17 July 2024: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 21 September 2017: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 21 September 2017: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
